operations.name: get_spendesk_invoice
operations.description: Returns a single supplier invoice by id. Invoice data is cached for up to 20 minutes. Changes, including those made through the API, can take up to 20 minutes to appear.

schema.description: Opaque unique identifier of an invoice.

operations.name: list_spendesk_company_users
operations.description: Returns members (users) of the given company. Useful for organisations with multiple companies (entities): a single organisation-level token can list the users of any company it owns by passing its `companyId`. User data is cached for up to 20 minutes. Changes made through the API are returned by subsequent reads; changes made in Spendesk can take up to 20 minutes to appear. A 403 means the token's organisation does not own `companyId`.

schema.description: Page number
Page size

operations.name: list_spendesk_expense_category_fields_v2
operations.description: Returns the expense category field for the company. The array is empty if the company has no expense category field configured. Expense category field data is cached for up to 24 hours. Changes made through the API are returned by subsequent reads; changes made in Spendesk can take up to 24 hours to appear.

operations.name: create_spendesk_expense_category_field_v2
operations.description: Creates the company's expense category field. A company can only have one expense category field; creating a second one returns a 409.

isRequired.description: Whether the field is mandatory. Defaults to true.

isSplittable.description: Whether the field is splittable. Defaults to false.

operations.name: delete_spendesk_expense_category_field_v2
operations.description: Deletes an expense category field by ID. Returns 404 if the field does not exist.

schema.description: Expense category field ID.

operations.name: get_spendesk_expense_category_field_v2
operations.description: Returns a single expense category field by ID. Returns 404 if the field does not exist. Expense category field data is cached for up to 24 hours. Changes made through the API are returned by subsequent reads; changes made in Spendesk can take up to 24 hours to appear.

schema.description: Expense category field ID.

operations.name: update_spendesk_expense_category_field_v2
operations.description: Updates the company's expense category field. Only the provided properties are changed; omitted properties are left untouched. Returns 404 if the field does not exist.

schema.description: Expense category field ID.

operations.name: list_spendesk_expense_categories_v2
operations.description: Returns expense categories for the expense category field, using forward-only cursor pagination. Returns 404 if the field does not exist. Expense categories are cached for up to 24 hours. Changes made through the API are returned by subsequent reads; changes made in Spendesk can take up to 24 hours to appear. Archived categories are included by default.

schema.description: Maximum number of categories to return.

operations.name: create_spendesk_users
operations.description: Create users in the company the token resolves to, and send each of them an invitation. Only active admins and account owners can perform this operation, and users can only be created with the `requester` or `controller` role. Send an array of 1 to 50 users; a single object outside an array is rejected with a 400. Users are created one after the other, and a user that fails does not prevent the others from being created: each one gets its own `outcome` in `items`, in request order, also when the

schema.description: Array of users to create (1 to 50).

costCenter.description: Name of an existing cost center of the company, set as the user default.

email.description: Work email of the user. It must not belong to any Spendesk user yet.

manager.description: Email of an existing member of the company, set as the user manager.

role.description: Role of the user in the company. Defaults to `requester`.

spendingPolicy.description: Name of an existing spending (approval) policy of the company.

operations.name: deactivate_spendesk_user
operations.description: Deactivate (offboard) a user from the company the token resolves to. Only admins and account owners can perform this operation. Scoped to that company: the user's membership, roles and delegations for the company are removed, cards/subscriptions are handled downstream, and the user is fully removed only if this was their last company. Cannot deactivate an organisation or account owner, or a user with pending transfers.

schema.description: ID of the user to deactivate.

operations.name: update_spendesk_user
operations.description: Partially update the profile of a user of the company the token resolves to. Only `firstName` and `lastName` can be updated; changing the email is not supported through the API. Names are shared by every company of the organisation, so the change is visible in all of them, and the user's sessions are kept. Users who are admin, account owner or travel manager in any company of the organisation cannot be updated, and companies whose users are managed by an HRIS integration are refused.

schema.description: ID of the user to update.

The cost centers feature must be enabled, and the cost center must be an active cost center of that company. Setting the same cost center again changes nothing, and when several updates of the user's cost center happen at the same time, the last one wins. schema.description: ID of the user to update.

costCenterId.description: ID of the cost center to set as the user's default, or `null` to clear it.
